answer_1.quote: The model is tasked with not only generating answers from retrieved contexts but also performing visual citation towards relevant document pages...
answer_1.outputs: Textual answers with visual citations (page and block-level coordinates)

answer_2.quote: To evaluate MLLMs' ability... we use the rule-based metric ROUGE. Additionally, we employ GPT-4o to assess the metric Acc... For visual citation... we introduce two automatic evaluation metrics: recall and precision.

answer_3.quote: we employ GPT-4o to assess the metric Acc, determining whether the generated responses align with the ground truths and are consistent with the visual context.

answer_4.quote: To complement IoU, we use human ratings of the predicted citations on a 0-5 scale... The guideline for rating is shown in Table of Appendix F.
answer_4.guideline: Annotation guideline for the Rating-based Human Evaluation... rating it from score 0 to 5... considering factors such as page and block relevance, offset from ground truth...
